_comment: Physics profile for the FAIRINO FR5 under Isaac Sim, consumed by
run_isaac_sim.py. Joint names and home pose must match the isaac branch of
controlled only, so there is no hand and no torque/velocity drive.
_home_comment: Spawn pose = zeros, matching config/initial_positions.yaml and the <state_interface> initial_value entries. (Zeros is a wrist singularity; move to a non-singular pose before task control.)
_armature_comment: Rotor inertia. The FR5 MuJoCo model authors none; 0.1 is the value used for the UR5e and Franka wrists and costs nothing here.
_position_gain_comment: MuJoCo position-actuator gains for this arm (xml/fr5.xml): kp 3000 / kv 300
for the three proximal joints and kp 1000 / kv 100 for the three wrists.
Use the same per-radian gains in Isaac so the two position-controlled plants
start from the same verified tuning. Effort still saturates at the URDF joint
limits (150/28 Nm), so validate and retune from an Isaac runtime trace.
